text:
Ibrahim: Quick announcement: we're piloting a 'spot cushion' billing feature to reduce surprise overage line items for small bursty customers. Summary below.
Ibrahim: TL;DR: 1) Per-account 90s cushion window at the billing aggregation layer that smooths microbursts before they become billable overages. 2) One-time automated 'onboarding cushion' credit for new accounts with projected MRR < $400, applied at first invoice. 3) Feature is pilot opt-in, runtime enforcement unchanged.
Clara: Confirming this is billing-aggregation only. No change to per-second throttles or Dedicated reserved capacity semantics.
Riley: Implementation notes: we'll add invoice line items `spot_cushion_adjustment` and `onboarding_cushion_credit` for transparency. Metadata: `cushion_window=90s`, `cushion_pilot=true`.
Jules: Finance: need GL mapping for both line items and decide if credit is contra-revenue. Also need sample CSVs for accounting teams in EU/US.
Finance: Noted. Please provide expected sample invoices; we'll validate tax treatment and reconciliation after deploy.
Ibrahim: Rollout: opt-in pilot of 60 accounts starting 2026-06-15T16:00Z, expand if variance <2% and reconciliation clean. GA TBD.
Billing-bot: INFO: scheduled deploy `deploy/billing/2026-06-15/spot-cushion-v1` at 2026-06-15T16:00:00Z (2805003600).
Riley: Migration/backfill: we'll backfill per-minute aggregates for the prior 48h for opt-ins, but backfill can be disabled per-account. Expect short DB CPU blips.
Support: We'll draft FAQ and canned responses. Need example invoices and a short blurb for the console opt-in UI.
Legal: Quick check  pilot fine; include clause: "Spot cushion credits are experimental and granted at the company's discretion." Add line about invoice transparency.
Clara: Monitoring: add metrics `billing.spot_cushion_applied`, `billing.onboard_cushion_count`, and alert if reconciliation delta > 0.5% of pilot spend.
Ibrahim: Action items: Eng (Riley) finalize migration & toggles, Finance provide GL mapping (Jules), Legal finalize wording, Support prepare FAQ and opt-in copy. I'll coordinate customer emails for the pilot cohort.
Finance: We'll aim to provide GL mapping and sample CSVs by EOD tomorrow.
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy started at 2026-06-15T16:00:12Z (2805003612).
Riley: Deploy completed, backfill running for 60 opt-ins. Backfill progress 60/60.
Support: Draft FAQ posted: https://docs.redwood/support/spot-cushion.md (WIP).
Ibrahim: Early reconciliation looks clean; will post 48h summary. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
